axebozo: The new rifleman gave his name as Oskar Axebozo. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
First Wave. Oskar Axebozo signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a key to a house that is no longer there.
Oskar Axebozo reported for duty as a chaplain. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Oskar Axebozo recovered it by touch and then had to wash again.

Oskar Axebozo was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers. Verdel Ridge is lost. Oskar Axebozo heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
The list for Oskar Axebozo's gathering contains a poem, a song and a request for five minutes without orders. All three seem possible.
Oskar Axebozo held the gathering in a shelter after supper. The poem was read badly, the song went better, and nobody interrupted the silence.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F13. Oskar Axebozo was the only one they could still help, and only just. A shell landed square in the trench at S-F13. Oskar Axebozo was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.
The papers connected Nils Axebozo to Oskar Axebozo. The men took longer to learn Nils Axebozo's own habits, but they made the effort.
hackermt90: Otto Hackermt joined the replacements on Day 3. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached S-F5 with the rations. Otto Hackermt ate while listening to the revised orders.
Otto Hackermt brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

A shell landed square in S-F5. They found Otto Hackermt alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. A shell landed square in the trench at S-F5. Otto Hackermt was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.
Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt had heard about Otto Hackermt's courage. At S-F5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt and Ulrich Asher carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
richard_mccooper: On Day 4, Jakub Mccooper arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Cyril "Ash" Slade pulled Jakub Mccooper out of a flooded shell hole at the Chalk Pits. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Jakub Mccooper pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
theramblingbot: Nobody asked Emil Theramblingb why he came. Nobody in S-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Emil Theramblingb tried writing with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will require imagination. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Emil Theramblingb stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord and Emil Theramblingb of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Hill 304 all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.

Emil Theramblingb counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home found Emil Theramblingb before the night shift. Emil Theramblingb folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Emil Theramblingb tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F16 is up. A bullet clipped Emil Theramblingb's helmet at S-F16 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Arno "Crow" Hakkinen of the Concord (@henri.hakkinen.566).
